latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Update Ariston to 0.19.19 to fix permanent Boost mode by @astrinh0 in https://github.com/fustom/ariston-remotethermo-home-assistant-v3/pull/559


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/fustom/ariston-remotethermo-home-assistant-v3/compare/v0.20.10...v0.20.11

hot_issues.title: [BUG] Ariston Nuos 250 SYS - no "Scheduled Comfort" represented
[BUG] HTTP 429 rate limit / "Requests are blocked" across multiple coordinators (bus_errors, state/menu_items, energy)
[BUG] Ariston Velis Evo WiFi LAST_DAY data seems to be 2-hour buckets (48 h), not hourly
[BUG] Central heating gas consumption sensor reports ~10x too high values after update
[FEATURE] Temporary temperature override with expiration time for Chaffoteaux boilers
binary_sensor.ariston_is_heating_pump_on is not working after every upgrade

discussions.title: How to turn off the heater GALEVO
Migrating domain from "ariston" to "ariston_remotethermo" due to Midea core integration (domain collision)
Changing the IoT Node Hostname in Ariston Thermo Appliances

# 🚀 Co-Maintainers Wanted! Hello everyone! Thank you to everyone who uses, stars, and contributes to this project. Due to work commitments and a busy schedule, I am no longer able to dedicate the time this project deserves. To keep the repository active and moving forward, I am looking for **co-maintainers** or a **new primary maintainer** to help lead the project. ### How You Can Help: * **Triage Issues:** Review, label, and respond to incoming issue reports. * **Review Pull Requests:** Help test, review, and merge community contributions. * **Maintenance & Enhancements:** Keep dependencies updated and work on planned roadmap features. ### Interested? If you've enjoyed using this project and would like to step up as a maintainer, please: 1. Write an email to me. 2. Briefly introduce yourself and share any prior experience or ideas you have for the project. Even if you can only contribute a few hours a month, your help would be hugely appreciated! Thanks for being part of the community! 🙌 [![CodeQL](https://github.com/fustom/ariston-remotethermo-home-assistant-v3/actions/workflows/codeql.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/fustom/ariston-remotethermo-home-assistant-v3/actions/workflows/codeql.yml) [![hacs_badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/HACS-Default-orange.svg)](https://github.com/hacs/integration) [![HACS Action](https://github.com/fustom/ariston-remotethermo-home-assistant-v3/actions/workflows/hacs.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/fustom/ariston-remotethermo-home-assistant-v3/actions/workflows/hacs.yml) [![Validate with hassfest](https://github.com/fustom/ariston-remotethermo-home-assistant-v3/actions/workflows/hassfest.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/fustom/ariston-remotethermo-home-assistant-v3/actions/workflows/hassfest.yml) # Ariston NET remotethermo integration for Home Assistant This integration inspired by chomupashchuk fantastic work https://github.com/chomupashchuk/ariston-remotethermo-home-assistant-v2 But it does not use Ariston website. It uses Ariston API what I reversed engineered. | [This integration](https://github.com/fustom/ariston-remotethermo-home-assistant-v3) | [Chomupashchuk's v2 integration](https://github.com/chomupashchuk/ariston-remotethermo-home-assistant-v2) | | ------------- | ------------- | | Uses real API | Uses Ariston website | | Faster set/get data | Sometimes needs minutes to set/get data | | Easy to setup with UI | Not so easy to setup (only with configuration.yaml) | | Integration & devices & entites | Only entites | | Proper asynchronous integration, clean code | Hard to understand and maintain (ariston.py has more than 4000 lines) | | Less sensors, switches, etc | More sensors, switches, etc | | New code, may contains lot of bugs | Old, tested code | ## TODO - Localization. Avaliable in english, catalan, italian, russian and ukranian. - More sensors, switches, binary sersors, selectors, services. - Exception handling. - More logs. - Fun. ## Integration was tested on and works with: - Ariston Alteas One 24 - Ariston Velis Evo - Ariston Velis Lux - Ariston Lydos Hybrid Feel free to test something else and create new issue / pull request if something goes wrong. ## Tests The test suite uses Home Assistant's pytest fixtures and reports line coverage for the integration. It runs on Python 3.14.2, matching CI. ```sh python -m pip install --require-hashes --only-binary=:all: -r requirements_test.txt python -m pytest ``` To update test dependencies, edit `requirements_test.in` and regenerate the hashed lock: ```sh uv pip compile requirements_test.in --python 3.14.2 --python-version 3.14.2 --universal --generate-hashes --upgrade --output-file requirements_test.txt ``` ## Installation [![Open your Home Assistant instance and open a repository inside the Home Assistant Community Store.](https://my.home-assistant.io/badges/hacs_repository.svg)](https://my.home-assistant.io/redirect/hacs_repository/?owner=fustom&repository=ariston-remotethermo-home-assistant-v3&category=integration) or copy ariston folder to your configuration/custom_components path. Use the add integration UI to set up your device. | ![Kazam_screenshot_00003](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6751243/146653448-ff7b6f9d-cbf1-4555-9a75-61bf68bc9d3e.png) | ![Kazam_screenshot_00004](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6751243/146653484-52e39d78-7c6f-44ae-888d-acf246147290.png) | ![Kazam_screenshot_00010](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6751243/147890590-6c4ebf38-16d9-421f-9b81-8f43298ec62f.png) | :-------------------------:|:-------------------------:|:-------------------------: ![Kazam_screenshot_00011](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6751243/147890611-54ae2d28-bf5a-45f8-ba92-e7a00a22615c.png) ![Kazam_screenshot_00012](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6751243/147989103-cdac510f-e6f6-461f-a88e-b8ff0204c34f.png) | ![Kazam_screenshot_00013](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6751243/148247717-5211c01c-561f-4a4e-b4b5-47a680e04a68.png) | ![Kazam_screenshot_00009](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6751243/146657797-ed14b741-595a-48a6-9126-1acca3beb69f.png) | :-------------------------:|:-------------------------:
